177:t_1:569.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you want to repay them... That's not bad.」

177:t_1:570.en:
$n
「Please tell me, $$ランド$$... How can I draw out the $$スフィア$$'s power?」

177:t_1:575.en:
$$ランド$$
「Letting some $$スフィア$$ push you around won't end well. If you want to get stronger, find another way.」

177:t_1:577.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$セツコ$$ told me earlier. She's going to teach you how to pilot, right?」

177:t_1:578.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll help you out too.」

177:t_1:580.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, don't get your hopes up too much. All I can really do to help is fix things and drink.」

177:t_1:582.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you can't be my drinking buddy...」

177:t_1:583.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll pass on what someone who took care of me taught me when I was your age.」

177:t_1:587.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm going to teach you to smile. Smile.」

177:t_1:588.en:
$n
「I can't just do that because you tell me to...」

177:t_1:589.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know what happened to you, and I can't fix it. So I'll teach you how to find the strength to keep living.」

177:t_1:592.en:
$$ランド$$
「From the bottom of your heart! Smile even when you're sad or hurting. The feeling will follow.」

177:t_1:593.en:
$$ランド$$
「Turn it all around! Then you can look ahead and move forward!」

177:t_1:596.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this, $n. If you're going to save me, I'll save you too.」

177:t_1:597.en:
$$ランド$$
「And just call me $$ランド$$. We're equals here.」

177:t_1:599.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It looks like you've already learned to smile from $$ランド$$.」

177:t_1:600.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Personally, I have a few complaints...」

177:t_1:601.en:
$$メール$$
「I know, I know! Once $n learns Darling's $$ヒートスマイル$$, all the girls will fall for him!」

177:t_1:604.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...As long as he's happy, that's what matters.」

177:t_1:605.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm not sure I follow, but let's call it all good.」

177:t_1:606.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, $$セツコ$$. Let's start $n's special training. I can at least play his opponent in a mock battle.」

177:t_1:607.en:
$n
「Sorry. I appreciate the offer, but I... have something to do after this...」

177:t_1:609.en:
$n
「Apparently, $$アルト$$'s been having nightmares lately. He's resting now too.」

177:t_1:610.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that you mention it, he isn't in the hangar...」

177:t_1:611.en:
$n
「I'm... going to check on him. It's not like there's anything I can do, but...」

177:t_1:612.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All right, $n. Let's start training once that's taken care of.」

177:t_1:613.en:
$$ランド$$
「Bring $$アルト$$ a smile. Good fortune comes to those who smile, as they say.」

177:t_1:615.en:
$n
「...Sorry. I'll stop by later, so please go ahead, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

177:t_1:616.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you have something to do?」

177:t_1:617.en:
$n
「Apparently, $$アルト$$ isn't feeling well, so I'm going to check on him.」

177:t_1:618.en:
$n
「They say he's been having nightmares lately.」

177:t_1:621.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's better than yours, $n. People tell you your smile looks scary.」

177:t_1:623.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm kidding. I was smiling because I'm happy to see how you've changed, $n.」

177:t_1:624.en:
$n
「Have I stopped being the quiet type!?」

177:t_1:625.en:
$$スズネ$$
(He's really eager... It must have bothered him quite a bit.)

177:t_1:627.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-well... Let's set that aside for now...」

177:t_1:630.en:
$n
「...Then I'll ask $$ボス$$ or $$木下$$ for special training...」

177:t_1:631.en:
$$スズネ$$
「J-just stop...! You don't have to force yourself to change your personality...!」

177:t_1:634.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, yes. Anyway, you're going to visit him, right?」

177:t_1:636.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's a good sign that he's starting to reach out to people himself. He might stop being the quiet type soon.)

177:t_1:637.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But I think I'll miss being the only person he opens up to...)

177:t_1:640.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-it's nothing! Say hello to $$アルト$$ for me.」

177:t_1:648.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You're always like that, $$アルト$$...」

177:t_1:649.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You always say $$シェリル$$'s name first... That time, and that time too...」

context_decisions: Rand asks Hibiki to smile and offers reciprocal help; request direction preserved. Suzune is amused by Hibiki reaching out to Alto, with jealousy in her private thoughts. Speaker labels override offset pid.
